description: The file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the ReviewKpiAPI within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It includes test cases for API methods such as retrieving all KPI reviews and handling unimplemented methods like create and delete.

classes.name: ReviewKpiAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ReviewKpiAPI endpoints, focusing on retrieval and validation of KPI review data in the HR management system.

methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetAll method, sourcing data from a YAML file.
